title: App Events
content_data:
> **Important**
> By using Events API endpoints, you agree to the [TikTok Business Products (Data) Terms](https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/policy/business-products-terms) and that you will not share sensitive data with TikTok. This group consists of the following endpoints: > **Note**
Events API - App is currently an allowlist-only feature. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative. * [Report an App Event](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740859196043266) * [Report App Events in bulk](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740859218541569) * [Get info of an app](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740859272887297) * [Create an app](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740859280958466) * [Update an app](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740859300069378) * [Get the app list](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740859313270786) * [Get App Conversion Events](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740859338750977) * [Get App Retargeting Events](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740859371033601)
